name: catalyst-26
description: Root manifest so the deploy builder provisions Node alongside Python. The backend serves frontend/dist (one deployable, CLAUDE.md §4), and dist/ is gitignored, so the frontend MUST be built at deploy time. With only requirements.txt here, Nixpacks detects Python alone and `npm` doesn't exist in the build image. Nothing depends on this file locally — build the frontend with `cd frontend && npm run build` as before.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
